sections.title: The -val/-vel again
sections.content: From the transport unit you know that *-val/-vel* means "with" for people: *Annával megyek.* It works with hobbies and meetings too, and it takes the same assimilation: *barát → baráttal*, *család → családdal*, *Meg → Meggel*. Ask with *Kivel?* (with whom?). *Találkozik* (meets) is the verb that always asks for *-val/-vel*: *Annával találkozom.*

items.english: Who do you play tennis with?
I go hiking with my family.

sections.content: *Találkozik* is an *-ik* verb: *találkozom*, *találkozol*. And the person you meet takes the ending, not the verb: *Annával találkozom*, never *Annát találkozom*.
